## Change

Describe the change and why it is needed. Explain the level; risk overrides size.
For L0/L1 this description is the change record: squash merge keeps it in Git.

<!-- sdd:metadata -->
Change-Level: REPLACE
Change-ID: none
<!-- /sdd:metadata -->

Replace REPLACE with L0, L1, L2, or L3. For an L2/L3 implementation, replace
none with its directory ID under docs/specs. Do not add target or skip flags.
A documentation-only proposal may use none and does not require a plan yet.

## How it was verified

List the checks that actually ran (command and result) and the `sdd-gate` result,
or state that it is blocked or skipped. Reference the plan's evidence for L2/L3.

## Acceptance criteria

For L2/L3, link the spec's AC and their evidence in the plan. For L0/L1, list the
one to three criteria checked, or remove this section when there are none.

## Evidence and review

Reference outstanding risks. For L3, identify independent review, findings, and
their resolution in the plan or review discussion. CI is not a substitute for the
review. The owner merges with squash; the agent never merges.
